name: CloudSecure-Core-Policy-Pack
author: SecOps Governance Team <secops@cloudsecure.dev>
description: Baseline security and compliance policy pack for multi-cloud infrastructure.

rules.name: AWS S3 Buckets Must Not Be Publicly Accessible
rules.rql_query: config from cloud.resource where api.name = 'aws_s3_bucket' and json.rule is_public is true
rules.description: Ensures no AWS S3 buckets allow unauthenticated public read or write access.
rules.remediation: Enable S3 Block Public Access on bucket settings.

rules.name: IAM Policies Must Not Grant Full Administrator Wildcard Access
rules.rql_query: iam from cloud.resource where api.name = 'aws_iam_policy' and json.rule has_admin_star is true
rules.description: Disallows custom IAM policies granting unrestricted Action=* and Resource=* access.
rules.remediation: Scope down IAM policy permissions according to the principle of least privilege.

rules.name: Databases Must Enforce Encryption at Rest
rules.rql_query: data from cloud.resource where api.name = 'aws_rds_instance' and json.rule storage_encrypted is false
rules.description: Verifies that production relational database storage volumes are encrypted at rest with KMS keys.
rules.remediation: Enable KMS encryption when provisioning or restoring the database instance.

rules.name: Security Groups Must Not Open SSH Port 22 to 0.0.0.0/0
rules.rql_query: network from cloud.resource where api.name = 'aws_security_group' and json.rule allows_public_ssh is true
rules.description: Ensures inbound SSH port 22 is not exposed to the public Internet.
rules.remediation: Restrict SSH ingress rules to corporate VPN or bastion host IP ranges.
